title: Unsupervised representation learning improves genetic discovery from spirograms and PPG
summary: REGLE uses convolutional variational autoencoders to compute low-dimensional embeddings of spirograms and photoplethysmograms. Genome-wide association studies on the embeddings found more genome-wide significant loci than existing methods and replicated known loci, embeddings were associated with overall survival, and derived polygenic risk scores improved prediction of asthma, COPD, hypertension and systolic blood pressure. New loci are statistical associations that the abstract does not report as experimentally confirmed. Preprint of 2023-04-29.
ai_technology: Convolutional variational autoencoder embeddings (REGLE) of spirograms and photoplethysmograms for GWAS and polygenic risk scores

evidence.tested: Replication of known loci and evaluation of polygenic risk scores in biobank data.
evidence.unknown: Biological function of newly reported loci and peer-reviewed status are not established; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Unsupervised deep learning produced embeddings used as phenotypes for genetic association and risk prediction.
